text:
1268 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not a century exception in the Julian calendar for that year).  
09-25-1268 minus 141 days:  
September has 30 days, so back to August: 25 days in Sep → Aug 31 is 25 days earlier, so 141 - 25 = 116 days earlier from Aug 31.  
August 31 back 31 days in July → July 31 (116 - 31 = 85 left).  
July has 31 days, back to June 30 (85 - 31 = 54 left).  
June has 30 days, back to May 31 (54 - 30 = 24 left).  
May 31 minus 24 days = May 7.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1268-05-07
